name: Beijing 51World Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing 51World Digital Twin Technology Co., Ltd. operates a digital twin technology company in China and Internationally. The company offers 51 All Elements Scene (AES) Digital Twin Platform, which includes AES digital base, infinite simulation engine, and world developer platform, a digital twin SaaS platform; 51Sim Synthetic Data and Simulation Platform comprising SimOne, a simulation platform for intelligent driving and robotics, DataOne, a data closed-loop and synthetic data platform, and TIM, a platform for traffic information modelling; and 51Earth Digital Earth Platform, a spatial management applications powered by natural language interaction.
